issue.body:
Replaced the simple logic that delegated to wildcardQuery() method with dedicated exact-match query logic for term queries.
Added test.

Closes #62081

issue.title: Wildcard field bug fix for prefix + term queries. Wildcard syntax should not be supported (#62085)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Wildcard field bug fix for term and prefix queries.
We now escape any * or ? characters in the search string before delegating to the main wildcardQuery() method.

Closes #62081
